captureCaveats: Window-only captures exclude the desktop and can render native backdrop contributions as dark/transparent. Not suitable for recovering real desktop blur radius, alpha, or final composite RGB.

Orca sometimes paired a new dialog AX tree with old standard-window geometry when a shortcut was sent to the standard window. Only explicit panel-id captures after fresh state reads were admitted to measurements.
During transitions, compositor/AX frame temporarily covered most of the display; not a content-size target.
AXSetValue updated text before results/intent settled. Intermediate captures with old Calculator results under a new question were excluded from normative state evidence.
Orca ArrowDown key spelling was unsupported; Down worked and selection was verified.
Finder AX initially reported permission_denied despite granted inventory. No permissions were toggled; Siri AX and trusted public event APIs worked.
No light-appearance switch, wallpaper change, Spaces transition, Sidecar interaction, hover test, Quick Look activation, or frame-timed animation recording.
nativeObservation.privacy: No personal history screenshots/trees retained. Root result names shown are code/artifact names without home paths. Benign arithmetic and sky questions were submitted for research. Existing conversations were not edited/deleted; research interactions may remain in native history. Microphone UI inspected without a spoken request. No running user processes terminated.

images.limit: Apple documentation illustration, not a capture of this machine. Intrinsic/presentation ratio does not prove capture scale or point dimensions. Copyright Apple; research reference only.
